verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਂਡ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਜਾਸ ਮਾਨਸ ਔਤਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: rom rom koT brahamaa(n)dd ko nivaas jaas maanas aauataar dhaar dharas dhikhaae hai(n) ||

en.bdb: Supreme Lord, whose each hair support millions of cosmos has incarnated as Satguru in human form.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa ke oa(n)kaar ke akaar hai naanaa prakaar sree mukh shabadh gursikhan sunaae hai(n) ||

en.bdb: The Omniprotector Lord who has many forms, appearing as Guru has given sermon to his disciples in person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਜਗਤ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖਨ ਲਡਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: jag bhog nieevedh jagat bhagat jaeh asan basan gurusikhan laddaae hai(n) ||

en.bdb: The God for whose propitiation yags are performed, food and offerings are made, the same Lord takes the form of Guru now coddling his Sikhs by distributing food and to his disciples.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਗਮ ਸੇਖਾਦਿਕ ਕਥਿਤ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit_en: nigam sekhaadhik kathit net net kar pooram braham gursikhan lakhaae hai(n) ||35||

en.bdb: The supreme Creator, whom Shesh Nag and others have calling by innumerable names, now manifests as Guru showing Himself to His devotees (The Sikhs). (35)
